scripts.build:deploy: pnpm --filter @notation-hero/server run build:lambda && pnpm --filter @notation-hero/client run build
scripts.check:all: pnpm run format:check && pnpm -r --if-present run lint && pnpm run lint:md && pnpm run lint:css && pnpm run lint:yaml && pnpm run lint:spell && pnpm run lint:shell && pnpm run lint:actions && pnpm run lint:editorconfig && pnpm run lint:sort-pkg && pnpm run check:layout && pnpm run check:coverage-ignore && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck && pnpm run depcheck && pnpm run check:core-purity && pnpm run syncpack && pnpm run check:supply-chain-pins && pnpm -r --if-present run test && pnpm run test:tooling
scripts.fix: prettier --write --ignore-unknown . ; pnpm --filter @notation-hero/client exec eslint . --fix ; pnpm --filter @notation-hero/server exec eslint . --fix ; pnpm --filter @notation-hero/web exec eslint . --fix ; stylelint --fix "**/*.css" ; markdownlint-cli2 --fix "**/*.md" ; git ls-files -z 'package.json' '*/package.json' | xargs -0 sort-package-json
scripts.pulumi:preview: pnpm run build:deploy && pnpm --filter @notation-hero/infra run pulumi:preview
scripts.pulumi:up: pnpm run build:deploy && pnpm --filter @notation-hero/infra run pulumi:up
scripts.test:tooling:sh: for t in tooling/*.test.sh; do [ -e "$t" ] || continue; echo "# $t"; bash "$t" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:vr:docker: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -v /work/client/node_modules -v /work/server/node_modules -v /work/shared/node_modules -v /work/infra/node_modules -v /work/web/node_modules -v /work/.pnpm-store -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.61.1-noble bash -c "corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm --filter @notation-hero/client run test:vr"
scripts.test:vr:docker:update: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -v /work/client/node_modules -v /work/server/node_modules -v /work/shared/node_modules -v /work/infra/node_modules -v /work/web/node_modules -v /work/.pnpm-store -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.61.1-noble bash -c "corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm --filter @notation-hero/client run test:vr:update"
